open_points.subject: Security-review scope for authentication and credential abuse
open_points.text: `authentication_credential_abuse: APPLICABLE; ... affected: M01-M15` still includes M08-M12, although R0-23 removes those five models; the adjacent `secrets` row was narrowed but this row was not.
open_points.question: Does the authentication review cover only the surviving models M01-M07 and M13-M15, or must M08-M12 remain as reserved security-review subjects despite being removed from the design?
options: Keep M08-M12 as reserved/tombstoned review subjects.
Treat the nonexistent models as an unresolved security-review failure.

witness.initial: States 0-2 have removed challenge and delivery models M08-M12, while A31 declares authentication review over M01-M15.
events: A later agent applies A31 while closing the security responsibilities for State 3.
The agent reaches model identifiers M08-M12, for which the accepted model text contains no models or behavior.
outcomes: The agent silently skips M08-M12 and records the category as resolved for the surviving IAM models.
The agent treats the missing models as required review subjects and either preserves challenge-related security work or blocks readiness.
witness.observer: The State 3 reviewer and any readiness gate consuming A31.
